description: QC-014 QAOA: certify the energy of a presented spin string on a presented Ising instance - the PROBLEM QAOA optimises, not a pulse schedule and not a search. edges are couplings i,j,J;... (integers), spins are +1,-1,... one per site. Returns the exact energy of the presented string, energy_num = the sum of J * s_i * s_j over the posted edges and energy_den = 1, detail energy=E. The verdict is graded against the one ground energy QMACourtLaw holds a seal for: -1, the frustrated triangle 0,1,1;1,2,1;2,0,1 with spins 1,-1,1 (fixtureSpinEnergy). WIN means the presented string reaches that energy; MISS means an evaluated string that does not - a MISS is never a malformed instance; a REFUSED_* verdict names an instance or string the law does not grade. Same law as route_spin_glass_manifold and math_court domain qc_qaoa. Floats refused (REFUSED_FLOAT); a field posted as a JSON value that is not a string is REFUSED_NOT_A_STRING.

spins.description: discrete spins +1,-1,... one per site, e.g. 1,-1,1

name: verify_qaoa_energy
